'''Vallis''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who visited<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Voss]] long before the planet's rediscovery during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Vallis was memorialized by a shrine in the area later known as the [[Nightmare Lands]].<ref name="TOR" />
